items.title: Storefront application is registered
items.acceptance_criteria: The release has a registered storefront application and reachable listing.

items.title: Declared meters have limits and enforcement
items.acceptance_criteria: Every declared meter has a tier limit and an exercised enforcement path.

items.title: A current bundle price exists
items.acceptance_criteria: The bundle has at least one enabled price row for this release.

items.title: Update policy is declared
items.acceptance_criteria: The scenario declares how updates are delivered and supported.

items.title: Per-platform assets are set
items.acceptance_criteria: Every declared target platform has its required release assets.

items.title: A brand assignment exists
items.acceptance_criteria: The scenario has a current brand-manager assignment or an explicit advisory finding.

items.title: Launch assets are answerable
items.acceptance_criteria: The launch-assets report names available channels and open artifact slots for the scenario.

items.title: Go-to-market and monetization documents have substance
items.acceptance_criteria: The declared commercial documents contain scenario-specific content rather than generator scaffold.

items.title: Ramp evidence exists for every target
items.acceptance_criteria: Each release target has current, attributable ramp evidence.

items.title: Suite state is known
items.acceptance_criteria: All required readiness signal producers return known, attributable states.

items.title: Declared features are reachable
items.acceptance_criteria: Every feature declared for sale is reachable in the built scenario.

items.title: Enforcement paths actually gate
items.acceptance_criteria: Each declared enforcement path refuses the corresponding simulated commercial condition.

items.title: Storefront copy describes this version
items.acceptance_criteria: Storefront claims correspond to the current release behavior.

items.title: Declared audience matches the build
items.acceptance_criteria: The declared audience is supported by the built experience.

items.title: Branding is applied and coherent
items.acceptance_criteria: The released experience applies the declared brand consistently.

items.title: Requirements cover what is sold
items.acceptance_criteria: Requirements and evidence cover every load-bearing commercial promise.

items.title: Subscription sign-in works end to end
items.acceptance_criteria: A new customer can sign in and receive the shared paid session.

items.title: Onboarding is usable by a paying customer
items.acceptance_criteria: A new paying customer can complete onboarding and reach the paid surface.

items.title: The gate is honest to a non-subscriber
items.acceptance_criteria: A refused user sees a clear reason and a reachable upgrade destination.

items.title: Stopping payment is survivable
items.acceptance_criteria: Cancellation or payment failure leaves the customer with an honest degraded experience.

items.title: A paying customer has a contact path
items.acceptance_criteria: A paying customer can reach the declared support or contact channel.
